module: Feeds the "tasks" app (task list at the top left) during a freeform delivery. It displays a header (delivery name), one task per active goal (placement, playerInVehicle, engineRunning, coupled, unhitched), a grouped "do not damage the cargo" task for damage goals, distance goals when their warning threshold is exceeded, and a message prompting to choose a route. The list is only rebuilt when a goal state hash changes.
notes: Tasks are sent to the UI by guihooks.trigger: ClearTasklist, SetTasklistHeader, SetTasklistTask {id, type, label, subtext, done, fail} and DiscardTasklistItem (id, optional delay).
Task ids: delivery_goal_<goalId>, delivery_damage, delivery_distance_<goalId>, delivery_route_prompt. A goal with showInTasklist == false is never displayed.
A completed goal with removeOnComplete is removed after a delay and does not return to the list (unless it becomes incomplete again).
The route prompt only appears once per delivery: as soon as a route is active, it is considered already shown.
Depends on the globals gameplay_freeformDelivery_goals and _odometer and on ui_appContainers, without declaring them in dependencies.

setup.desc: Displays the "tasks" app, clears the list, resets the caches, sends the header (delivery name), builds the initial list and the route message.

update.desc: Called every frame: updates the odometer message, computes a hash of the goal state (including the progress of multi-vehicle goals) and rebuilds the list if something changed.

updateRouteMessage.desc: Removes the old route messages and, if there are routes but no active guidance (core_groundMarkers.currentlyHasTarget) and the prompt has not yet been shown, displays the message prompting to choose a route via the big map. Called by routes.lua.

cleanup.desc: Clears the header, tasks and route messages from the UI.
